content:
elaine.sales: Kyros RFP landed — they want FedRAMP IL2 (in-scope controls), HSM-backed KMS, EU data residency (eu-west-1), and a 30-day PoC with an SLA. They asked for a capability matrix + PoC SOW by Thu EOD. Can we confirm feasibility and a quick owner list? @mike.se @sarah.security :eyes:

mike.se: Short answer: doable via Redwood Private + HSM integration for full customer KMS. Hosted can meet some controls but not vendor-attested HSM. Need to confirm exact HSM vendors and attestation level (FIPS 140-2/3).

sarah.security: Agree. We support KMIP + customer HSM in Private. For FedRAMP claims we can provide SOC2 + our security blog, but FedRAMP authorizations required by the customer will need either our partner-hosted environment or they will host on-prem. Ask Kyros which controls they consider "must-have" vs "nice-to-have". Also need their IL2 scoping doc.

bryan.se: I can draft the capability matrix and PoC SOW. What columns do we want? My suggestion: Feature, Compliance posture (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), Notes (attestation/files), PoC steps, ETA.

jordan.devx: For the 30-day PoC, are they expecting perf benchmarks (p50/p95 latency) or functional validation only? Also confirm if they want token-level cost modeling.

anne.legal: If they want FedRAMP statements in writing we need to route through Legal — no standing FedRAMP claims without authorizing docs. Also will need an MSA addendum for BYO-HSM and data residency.

bryan.se: Draft matrix + PoC SOW (first pass) below — feedback welcome. I'll upload a spreadsheet shortly.

```
Capability | Hosted | Dedicated | Private (VPC)
---|---|---|---
FedRAMP IL2 | Partial (partner tech partners) | Partial (depends on config) | Full (customer controls + BYO-HSM)
BYO-HSM | No | Limited (vendor managed) | Yes (KMIP / HSM attestation)
Data residency | Region-level routing | Region pinning | Full customer-controlled region
SLA | 99.9% | 99.95% | Contracted per SOW
KMS Integration | Redwood KMS | Reserved KMS config | Customer-managed KMS/HSM
PoC complexity | Low | Medium | High
```

PoC SOW (short):
```
Week 0: NDA + SOW signoff + inventory (HSM vendor + certs)
Week 1: Network setup, VPC peering, HSM onboarding (KMIP cert exchange)
Week 2: Integration test (KMS ops), basic perf runs (10k tokens/day)
Week 3: Scale perf and latency tests (p50/p95) + security validation
Week 4: Acceptance testing, deliverable report, sign-off or follow-ups
```

deploy-bot: New file uploaded by bryan.se: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Kyros-RFP-attachments (capability-matrix-v1.xlsx, poc-sow-draft.md) :paperclip:

sarah.security: Uploaded attestation ask: we need vendor HSM certs (FIPS level), SOC2, encryption-in-transit diagrams, and any FedRAMP scoping statements from Kyros. Can someone ping the Kyros security contact for the attestation pack?

elaine.sales: I'll ping them now. Action items: (1) bryan.se finalize matrix + upload v2 by tomorrow AM, (2) mike.se confirm whether Dedicated can be configured to surface vendor attestation by EOD, (3) anne.legal prep MSA addendum template for BYO-HSM, (4) sarah.security produce checklist of required certs. If we get their attestation pack by EOD Wed we can keep Thu deadline. :thumbsup:

bryan.se: On it — will have v2 by 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

mike.se: Will verify with infra team and revert by EOD.

elaine.sales: thanks team, I'll update Kyros after we have the v2 upload.
